ModMetaData.name: Shared Beds
ModMetaData.author: A. Medrano
ModMetaData.description:
Beds are unused two thirds of the time. Shared Beds lets you mark any colonist bed as "shared" (gizmo next to Medical / For prisoners, pink sheets).
A shared bed has no permanent owner: a colonist claims it when going to sleep and releases it when waking up. Great for barracks, shift work, camps, polyamorous colonists, gravships or Wake-up fuelled colonies.
Bed choice when going to sleep: 1. Own (permanently assigned) bed, as in vanilla. 2. The shared bed a lover is sleeping in, if there is a free slot. 3. The shared bed they used last, or the best free one. 4. Vanilla: claim an unowned normal bed.
While sleeping in a shared bed colonists really own it, so bedroom/barracks thoughts, greedy and jealous all work as usual. Trade-off: a small "no personal space" mood debuff (configurable) after sleeping in a shared bed.
